CAN ID 0x4C9 showed a rate of 18.0 msg/s, which is 1.8x its baseline of 10.0 msg/s, with a mean gap of 56.242 ms compared to a 99.978 ms baseline.
CAN ID 0x280 showed a rate of 10.0 msg/s, which is 1.667x its baseline of 5.03 msg/s.
The overall peak bus rate was 2436 msg/s, only 1.02x the baseline of 2392 msg/s, indicating no significant bus flooding.
The affected vehicle functions for IDs 0x4C9, 0x280, 0x69D, 0x075, 0x3B9, and 0x4EE are not identified.

explanation.recommended_action: Investigate the source of the additional frames for IDs 0x4C9 and 0x280 and verify if these rate increases correspond to any legitimate vehicle state changes not captured in the baseline.

scoring: Attack-label accuracy on frozen alerts; failures count as incorrect, never control predictions. Normal alerts scored separately. Development corpus, not an untouched test set.

grounding.meaning: Citation validity only; semantic claim support needs review
